desc.zh: 把短单词的两端配对，推导最大下标为何能安全覆盖。
desc.en: Pair the ends of short words and derive why later indices safely overwrite earlier ones.

complexity: Expected O(nL³) construction time; O(nL³) space; O(|pref|+|suff|) time per query

concepts.name: Prefix–suffix pair invariant
concepts.description: Enumerate all nonempty end pairs and retain the latest matching original index.
